uniques: Creates a [Diplomatic Quarter] district on a specific tile

civilopediaText.text: A district dedicated to diplomacy and espionage. Contains the Consulate and Chancery.
The ziggurat of Babylon, the house of the foundation of heaven and earth. Provides bonus Science and Great Scientist points.
The world's first public bathhouse from Mohenjo-daro. Provides Housing, Faith, and prevents Flood damage.
The grand tomb of Mausolus. Provides bonus Great Engineer points and extends their benefits.
The great temple of Tenochtitlan. Provides Culture, Faith, and Lake adjacency bonuses.
A medieval abbey on a tidal island in Normandy. Provides Faith and +1 charge for Apostles and Missionaries.
A historic center of learning in Timbuktu. Provides Science and Great Scientist points.
The Spanish House of Trade in Seville. Provides Gold and Great Merchant points.
A fortified tower on the Lisbon coastline. Provides Gold, Great Admiral points, and Trade Route bonuses.
The Hungarian Parliament Building in Budapest. Provides Culture and Gold.
A ship canal connecting the Atlantic and Pacific. Ships may traverse between two bodies of water.
A geodesic dome in Montreal dedicated to environmental science. Provides Science and Environmental bonuses.
Rio de Janeiro's legendary football stadium. Provides Culture, Amenities, and Tourism.

name: Golf Course
uniques: Creates a [Golf Course] district on a specific tile

civilopediaText.text: A Scottish unique district replacing the Entertainment Complex. Cheaper to build and provides amenities.
